landing.title: Procept: The Hollistic Action Center for your AI-Powered Supply Chain
landing.subtitle: Fix Broken Data. Automate Procure-to-Pay. Traceable at Every Single Step.
landing.problemTitle: Problem: Your Procurement and Operations Teams are Reactive not Proactive
landing.problemDesc1: For procurement and operations teams, every discrepancy across the ERP, email, and 3PL logistics or manufacturing partners is entirely manual. Someone has to catch these errors and manually perform saving actions to keep the business moving.
landing.problemDesc2: The most common administrative bottlenecks draining your margins:
landing.immediateIssue1: Critical updates lost in email wars involving 30 people.
landing.immediateIssue2: Lack of automated reporting or photos for overages, shortages, and damages.
landing.immediateIssue3: Changes in the ERP aren't reflected in the warehouse system.
landing.immediateIssue4: Converting unstructured documents to ERP entries and executing risky mass updates manually.
landing.longTermIssue1: Gathering the right data is so painful that many manufacturers simply give up and rely strictly on trailing sales figures.
landing.longTermIssue2: Manual "packets" and vetting process is too slow.
landing.longTermIssue3: Manual matching of tariff reports to POs and SKUs.
landing.longTermIssue4: Difficulty getting clean data in/out of NetSuite, SAP, or JDE.
landing.statsIntro: While most organizations realize they need to integrate and automate, they struggle finding the strategy and implementation that will actually deliver. Legacy EDI and expensive implementations often result in:
landing.stat1Desc: of buyer time wasted on manual purchase order and invoice reconciliation.
landing.stat2Desc: average industry PPV margin leakage due to delayed master data pricing updates.
landing.stat3Desc: lag time attempting to resolve "black hole" shipping damage and shortage claims.
landing.solutionTitle: Our Solution: Autonomous Agents Catching Catastrophies Before They Reach the Customer
landing.solutionDesc2: deploys specialized, autonomous agents that continuously monitor your ERP, WMS, and unstructured communications to proactively identify and resolve your most expensive administrative bottlenecks. By bridging disconnected data silos into a central action command, we empower your team to approve complex workflow corrections with a single click, transforming reactive manual data wrangling into a unified, zero-error supply chain operation.
landing.scenario1Bul1B: Attaches directly to your ERPs, 3PL platforms, and unstructured email communications.
landing.scenario1Bul2B: Continuously scans underlying operations data to catch discrepancies
landing.scenario1Bul3B: Isolates errors and proactively formats structured resolution tasks for single-click human approval.
landing.scenario1Bul4B: Systematically eliminates manual data entry waste, pricing fumbles, and reactive administrative friction.
landing.scenario2Bul1B: Once automated agents scrub your operational data repositories, you achieve absolute cleanliness.
landing.scenario2Bul2B: Unlocks enterprise-tier capabilities without requiring an immense in-house AI and data engineering team.
landing.scenario2Bul3B: Replaces manual vetting and reporting with real-time, highly accurate supplier analytics.
landing.scenario2Bul4B: Exposes SKU volatility and prevents stock-outs through deep forecasting rather than blind sales reliance.
landing.govDesc: Every action Procept takes must be approved by a team member and is rigorously confirmed with your own rules-based ERP change logs, immediately.
landing.q1Title: "Can Procept catch 'Phantom Lead Times' where SAP perfectly says 30 days, but the vendor actually takes 45 days in reality?"
landing.q1A1B: Procept conducts background analysis on your last 10 email threads and receiving receipts to mathematically prove the supplier is delivering in 45 days. It intervenes and flags the stale data
landing.q1A1D: the next MRP run generates bad purchasing schedules.
landing.q1ResultB: Buyers order on the correct timeline, avoiding massive expedited freight costs and preventing stockouts.
landing.q2Title: "What if a user changes a shipping address or ship method in the ERP, but it never makes it to the 3PL's warehouse system?"
landing.q2A1B: It constantly cross-checks the ERP with your 3PL. If there's a mismatch on cuts, cancels, or addresses, it holds fulfillment immediately, routes a structured update task to the warehouse contact, and releases the hold only when they explicitly acknowledge the change.
landing.q2ResultB: Zero wrong-ship/reship costs caused by the standard 'our side vs your side' data gap.
landing.q3Title: "Can it actually manage the chaos of Shortage Claims when the warehouse receives fewer units than ordered?"
landing.q3A1B: Normally this triggers a 'black hole' email loop. Instead, the agent intercepts the warehouse's shortage log and photo, cross-references the original PO, and autonomously drafts a complete credit claim packet for AP—automatically blocking the vendor invoice.
landing.q3ResultB: Drastically higher vendor credit recovery without bleeding AP/Procurement tracking time.
landing.q4Title: Q: Can it handle "Lazy" Vendor Onboarding?
landing.q4A1B: If a vendor emails a messy mix of phone photos and inline text, the agent extracts the unstructured data and stages the W-9 and banking details perfectly into your ERP master record.
landing.q5Title: Q: Does it catch Rogue Invoice Pricing?
landing.q5A1B: If an invoice arrives at $12.50 vs the PO's $10.00, Procept catches it from the email, blocks AP processing, and drafts a structured dispute to the vendor before you ever pay it.
landing.q6Title: Q: What about Tariff Shock Repricing?
landing.q6A1B: When new freight tariffs drop, the system maps the hike to affected POs and customer price books, calculating your margin impact and automatically proposing updates.
landing.q7Title: Q: Can it predict Sudden SKU Stockouts?
landing.q7A1B: Procept's background telemetry detects burn-rate anomalies, predicting a stockout ahead of time, and instantly generates an expedited Air Freight PO request.
landing.quoteMainPoint: Data Fragmentation Problems Stop Procurement and Operations Teams in their Tracks
landing.quoteText: When procurement data doesn't align with inventory systems, or when transportation information lives separately from demand planning, AI tools can't deliver the connected intelligence that supply chain leaders need.
landing.quoteSource: TraxTech - Why AI Fails in Supply Chain
